CFB-week.summary: Week 12/13 slate is led by LSU at Tennessee (Tennessee starting QB undecided after MacIntyre's injury), Ohio State at Nebraska, Texas A&M at Oklahoma, Georgia at South Carolina and SMU at No. 3 Notre Dame. UCLA plays Michigan without QB Iamaleava (out for the season). Few books post full prop menus for college games, so most lines here are passing yards plus single receiving/rushing yard props.

NBA-CHA-at-ATL-1121.summary: Both backcourts are thin. Charlotte is without Schroder, Knueppel, Grayson Allen and Grant Williams, leaving Coby White and Brandon Miller to carry the creation; Atlanta is without CJ McCollum (calf, 4+ weeks) and Kingston Flemings (back) is questionable after missing the last two games, so wings including Alexander-Walker share the playmaking.

NBA-HOU-at-DEN-1121.summary: Houston's frontcourt is thin: Capela is out, Steven Adams (quad) and Alperen Sengun (eye) are both questionable, so Houston's minutes and playmaking at center hinge on late news. Denver lists only Julian Strawther out. The total has moved up from 223.5 to 226 with Denver a slight favorite.

NBA-SAC-at-LAL-1121.summary: Austin Reaves (heel bruise, called day-to-day with no structural damage) is out again, so the Lakers keep the lineup that has been winning without him, with Grimes starting. Sacramento lists De'Andre Hunter questionable (hip), Precious Achiuwa doubtful and Maxime Raynaud out, which thins its forward and center depth.

NBA-TOR-at-DET-1121.summary: Cade Cunningham is listed probable with right knee soreness after sitting out Wednesday's win over New Orleans; no minutes limit has been reported. Toronto is without RJ Barrett (hamstring, re-check in two weeks), Collin Murray-Boyles (concussion protocol) and Kawhi Leonard, with Quickley and Barnes back in the starting group.

NFL-ARI-at-KC-1122.summary: Kenneth Walker has missed practice again with a groin injury and rookie Emmett Johnson is expected to start for the second week in a row after 22 carries, 6 catches and 2 TDs against Atlanta. Kansas City is also expected to use backups at right guard and right tackle (Ezeudu, Caliendo) with Trey Smith in concussion protocol and Jaylon Moore out of practice. Arizona's rookie QB Carson Beck, starting only because of a trade and a season-ending injury ahead of him, was limited Thursday with a back issue.

NFL-JAX-at-NYG-1122.summary: Bhayshul Tuten was downgraded from limited Wednesday to no practice Thursday with an ankle/foot problem, and Rodriguez (hand) and Allen (hamstring) are both limited, so Jacksonville's backfield is unsettled. Jakobi Meyers (ankle) was limited both days, center Robert Hainsey is out and his backup Monheim is limited; for the Giants, Skattebo practiced fully and CB Nic Jones has not practiced. Rain and gusty wind are in the MetLife forecast.

NFL-NO-at-CHI-1122.summary: The big Bears change is Kyle Monangai returning (full practice, toe) after five games out; Swift took over goal-line work while Monangai was out and scored 7 of his 10 TDs in that stretch, so expect a split near the goal line. New Orleans' line is battered (McCoy and Fuaga doubtful, Richards out) and WR Jordyn Tyson is questionable; Sunday brings a 70% rain chance with gusts near 20 mph. ESPN's main DraftKings listing shows Bears -6.5 and total 46.5, versus the packet's -11.5 / 48.5 (the packet figures appear as alternate lines there).

NFL-NYJ-at-LAC-1122.summary: Jets QB Geno Smith is limited with a left ankle sprain but says he plans to play; the fallback is rookie Cade Klubnik, who was shaky in relief. Jets WRs Omar Cooper Jr. (re-aggravated high ankle) and Isaiah Williams (ribs) did not practice Thursday, which concentrates targets on Garrett Wilson and Adonai Mitchell if both sit. The Chargers keep rotating three backs, which caps Omarion Hampton's passing-game work.

NFL-PIT-at-PHI-1122.summary: Joe Milton makes a second straight start for 2-7 Philadelphia with Jalen Hurts on IR; the Eagles get DeVonta Smith back (full Thursday) while Dontayvion Wicks was limited all week and LB Zack Baun has not practiced. Pittsburgh's Michael Pittman Jr. moved from limited to full in his return from IR, and Warren and Dowdle continue to split the backfield. Rain (around 80% chance) and gusts near 21 mph are forecast with a low 38.5 total.

NFL-TB-at-DET-1122.summary: Everything on the Tampa side hinges on Baker Mayfield's foot: he was in and out of a walking boot over the bye, missed Wednesday, was limited Thursday, and the team won't name a starter before Friday (rookie Jalon Daniels is the fallback). The spread moved from Bucs +5.5 to +7 on the news. Detroit is expected without C Cade Mays and has several questionable corners.

NFL-TEN-at-DAL-1122.summary: Dallas is an 8.5-point home favorite with a 54.5 total indoors. Jake Ferguson is out again and backup TE Luke Schoonmaker was ill Thursday, so Dallas targets stay concentrated on Lamb and Pickens, with Spann-Ford at tight end; CB DaRon Bland and RG Tyler Booker are out. Tennessee lost slot WR Wan'Dale Robinson for the season and promoted Xavier Restrepo; Carnell Tate (shoulder) and Tyjae Spears (knee) were limited.

SOCCER-day.summary: Alexander Prass is a doubt for Hoffenheim at Frankfurt after leaving Austria's camp early with a knock that followed a muscle issue earlier in November. Arsenal go to Newcastle without Saka (injured) and Dowman (suspended), with Zubimendi a major doubt; Spurs are missing Simons and Odobert with Tel a major doubt for Ipswich.

fix.summary: Baltimore is without Lamar Jackson (IR, thumb) and starts Jacoby Brissett; Houston's Sengun and Adams are questionable with Capela out; Texas A&M's Craver was a game-time decision last week; Jacksonville's Meyers was limited all week.

NBA-GS-at-MEM-1120.summary: Golden State is on a back-to-back after losing at Dallas: Curry (oblique tear), Porzingis, Butler, Moody and Brandon Williams are out, Draymond Green sits Thursday and Al Horford returns from rest on limited minutes. Memphis, also on a back-to-back after playing in Cleveland, has Isaiah Stewart (illness) and Ty Jerome (hip) day-to-day after both sat Wednesday; Jackson, Pippen and Saunders are out.

NBA-NY-at-MIN-1120.summary: Minnesota remains without Anthony Edwards (knee surgery, out to around late December), Jaylen Clark and DiVincenzo; Jonathan Kuminga (shoulder contusion) and Zyon Pullin (quad) are questionable. If Kuminga sits, McDaniels and Terrence Shannon Jr. are expected to take on more minutes. The Knicks report no injuries, with Josh Hart back from a three-game absence.

NBA-POR-at-MIL-1120.summary: Portland's Deni Avdija (left foot soreness) and Toumani Camara (abdominal soreness) are game-time decisions; Robert Williams III (rest), Sharpe, Morant, Krejci and Youngblood are out. Milwaukee's Ryan Rollins (illness) is day-to-day after missing Wednesday, Dieng is out, and the Bucks are on a back-to-back as 9.5-point home underdogs.

NFL-IND-at-HOU-1120.summary: Houston plays without Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring, DNP all week) and Woody Marks (concussion), while David Montgomery (groin) comes back with no designation after missing four games, and Emari Demercado backs him up. Indianapolis is missing both starting tackles (Raimann, Travis), CB Charvarius Ward and TE Will Mallory, and Sauce Gardner is questionable after DNPs Monday and Tuesday. Pre-deadline trades (Downs, Allen) and Pierce on IR leave Treadwell and Burks as the top wideouts. The spread grew from HOU -9.5 on Monday to -12.5.
